title: 2027 Toyota Tundra: Did Toyota Fix the Engine? What We Know So Far
description:
The Toyota Tundra keeps eighty percent of its value after five years, and it is one of the trucks most likely to reach two hundred fifty thousand miles. But the same truck was ranked last for reliability by one of the biggest truck sites in America, because of engine failures that sometimes meant a whole new engine. For twenty twenty-seven, Toyota says the problem has been addressed. Here is what changed, what did not, and whether you should believe it.
